## Activity

During December 2022, East City Eye Clinic recorded 173 captures. Activity was completed in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The reported volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 173 captures, 4 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.3. The result is recorded for monitoring purposes and should be considered alongside the overall activity level for December 2022. No further interpretation of the ungradable images is included in this report.

## Grading

Grading identified 52 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This provides the central measure of the time taken for images to progress from capture to a grading outcome. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures summarise the operational performance recorded at East City Eye Clinic during December 2022.
